column1: # Where the highlight queries compiled into opencode-native come from, and their licences. Each source URL in the
# client's packages/cli-rs/assets/queries/manifest.json is matched against every pattern (fnmatch); a source no row
# matches fails notices/queries.py, so a new query source needs a row and its licence text in notices/licenses.
# The queries @opentui/core bundles are OpenTUI's copies of upstream queries (its parsers-config.ts names them), so
# they carry OpenTUI's licence and the upstream one.
